title: Pairs has a Stage-0 verdict that no guard can see — it lives in a sprint log, not in the evidence system
note: FOUND 2026-09-22. MEASURED: `ls comms/strategy_evidence/ | grep -i pairs` returns NOTHING, and `grep -c pairs_ config/strategies.yaml config/accounts.yaml` returns 0 and 0. So no pairs leg has an evidence record, appears in the 12-slot risk-bearing census, or is visible to scripts/ci/check_roster_promotion_evidence.py. [!] AND THERE IS A VERDICT TO RECORD -- IT IS JUST IN THE WRONG PLACE. docs/sprint-logs/S-M22-D2-PAIRS-READINESS-2026-07-16.md carries the G2 evidence (trainer-diag #6612/#6615, real candles at bybit_2 risk_pct 0.015): R-space net_R +513..+825 collapses to net-negative in dollars; fee-free SOL/ETH +$1279, BNB/BTC +$357, SOL/BTC -$295, ETH/BTC -$855; '7.5bps taker x 2 legs x ~2800 trades tips all four deeply negative. The loss is fees.' [!] THE CONSEQUENCE IS NOT BOOKKEEPING: B1's guard keys on roster membership and evidence records, so A PAIRS LEG COULD BE ROUTED TO A REAL-MONEY ROSTER TOMORROW WITHOUT TRIPPING ANYTHING, on a family whose only committed backtest says it loses money net of fees. A negative backtest no guard can read is the same defect class as E25 (fvg_range had no harness route) and E28 (ict_scalp has none) -- except here the measurement EXISTS and is simply unreachable. [!] DELIVERABLE: a Stage-0 evidence record per configured pair, in the standard comms/strategy_evidence/ shape, carrying the 2026-07-16 numbers with their source_run and a decision_rule verdict -- OR, if those numbers cannot be reconstructed to the current schema, a `coverage_state` that says so honestly rather than leaving the family absent. Absent and failing are different states and today they are indistinguishable. [!] 2026-10-07 (lane PAIRS-STOCKTAKE): still no pairs record (`ls comms/strategy_evidence | grep -i pairs` empty, re-measured). The producer (build_strategy_evidence.py / regime_debt_matrix.py) has no `pairs` family, so the record cannot be generated by it. RQ-20261007-005..008 now produce, per pair, a full-cost Stage-0 verdict at the CONFIGURED params plus a committed trades.jsonl ledger under comms/research/<unit>/<run_id>/ -- the source_run a record here can cite. Stocktake: docs/research/pairs-stocktake-2026-10-07.md.
